subject: Request: Fellowship credits & extended trial for Community Data Science Collective
messages:
From: Alex Sanchez <alex.sanchez@greenfieldlab.org>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Fellowship credits & extended trial for Community Data Science Collective

Hi Soojin,

I hope you’re well — I’m Alex, program director at Greenfield Community Data Collective (we’re a small nonprofit that runs a 12-week fellowship for community researchers and grad students). We’ve been evaluating Redwood for a pilot to provide compute credits and a low-cost inference path for our fellows to run literature summarization and small-model experiments.

Two asks:
- Would Redwood consider providing a one-time credit grant to support ~10 fellows (estimate: 8k–12k tokens per fellow over 12 weeks)?
- If possible, could we get a 3-month trial extension on the hosted API while we run the program (current free tier expires in Sept)?

I’ve attached a short fellowship proposal and our nonprofit paperwork (501c3 + W9). Happy to share more details. If this would be handled by someone else, please point me to the right contact.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Sanchez
Program Director | Greenfield Community Data Collective
alex.sanchez@greenfieldlab.org | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: GCDC_fellowship_proposal.pdf, GCDC_501c3_and_W9.pdf

From: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Sanchez <alex.sanchez@greenfieldlab.org>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Fellowship credits & extended trial for Community Data Science Collective

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and for sending the materials.

This is exactly the kind of community program we want to support. Two quick clarifying questions so I can route internally:
1) Are the fellows using the hosted API (we assume yes) or do you intend a short Dedicated/Private evaluation?
2) Can you confirm the expected peak concurrency and whether there will be any PII or protected data in the prompts?

I’m looping in Monica (CS lead) and Marcus (sales) so we can review the paperwork and the ask. Monica — can you advise on standard nonprofit credit grants and whether we can do a 3-month extension? Marcus — for larger credits we typically create a sponsored grant/deal in HubSpot; any objections to GCDC-2027-FELLOWSHIP-01?

Alex — if agreeable, I’ll propose a quick 20-min call for next week to align on scope.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Partnerships | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0108

From: Alex Sanchez <alex.sanchez@greenfieldlab.org>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@greenfieldlab.org>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Fellowship credits & extended trial for Community Data Science Collective

Thanks, Soojin — quick answers below.

1) Hosted API only — fellows will access via shared project API keys we manage.
2) Peak concurrency: very low (mostly single-user experiments, maybe 2–3 concurrent requests during demo days). No PII; prompts are research questions and public datasets.

I’ve also added Emma (our operations manager) if you need anything else.

Would appreciate the 3-month extension if possible; the fellowship starts Sept 15 and runs through Dec 15.

— Alex

[On Fri, 6 Aug 2027 08:37:00 -0700 Alex included attachments: GCDC_fellowship_proposal.pdf, GCDC_501c3_and_W9.pdf]

From: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Sanchez <alex.sanchez@greenfieldlab.org>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 7 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Fellowship credits & extended trial for Community Data Science Collective

Hi Alex — quick update after internal review.

We can approve a community grant of 10,000 free hosted-api credits for the Greenfield Community Data Collective and extend your trial window through 2027-12-31 (covers your Sept 15–Dec 15 fellowship). A few operational notes:
- We’ll provision the grant to a new sponsored account tied to your organization; Monica will send instructions for key generation and safe key handling.
- Because you’re using shared keys across fellows, please follow our documented best practices for rate limits and per-user quotas (Monica’s note below).
- No additional compliance artifacts required given no PII; we retained a copy of your W9/501c3 in the deal record.

Monica — can you send the onboarding checklist + quota configuration? Marcus — I created deal GCDC-2027-FELLOWSHIP-01 in HubSpot (link below). Neha — FYI for credit accounting and grant program reporting.

Alex — if that sounds good, Monica will send the provisioning steps and we’ll mark the deal as Sponsored Grant / Non-revenue. We’ll also set a reminder to follow up in mid-November to check usage and impact.

Best,
Soojin

--
Monica Patel (Customer Success)
Monica will send the onboarding checklist and a short doc with quota templates and recommended batching/temperature settings for research workloads.
